assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md line 5 states 'Running discovery mode to list Vulnerability issues in project TC using vulnerability issue type ID 10024 (extracted from Security Configuration in CLAUDE.md).' All three queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024'. Lines 17-18 annotate: 'TC — Project key from Jira Configuration' and '10024 — Vulnerability issue type ID from Security Configuration'.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: Query 1 (line 14): 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)'. Query 2 (line 49): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New'. Query 3 (line 67): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, ON_QA)'. All three queries match the expected JQL patterns exactly.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three H2 sections separated by '---' dividers: 'Query 1: Untriaged Issues' (line 9), 'Query 2: Triaged but still New' (line 44), 'Query 3: Ready for QA' (line 63). Each section contains its own results.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: Query 1 issues use format 'TC-9001 | Status: New | CVE: CVE-2026-40112 | Summary: CVE-2026-40112 h2 - HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability [rhtpa-2.2] | Created: 2026-06-08' (all five fields present). Query 2 uses the same format. Query 3 uses a table with columns: Issue, Status, CVE, Summary, Created, Remediation Tasks. All listed issues across all three queries include all five required fields.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md: TC-9001 (line 12): 'Proceed with full triage (default path).' TC-9002 (line 24): 'Proceed with full triage (default path).' TC-9004 (line 52): 'Proceed with full triage (default path).' TC-9003 (line 34): 'Warning — active work detected.' with 'This issue is already in In Progress. It may be actively worked on.'

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md: TC-9020 in 'Qualified for Ready for QA' table (line 81) with 'TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'. TC-9023 excluded (line 90): 'Remediation in progress: TC-9025 is still In Progress (TC-9024 is Done)'. TC-9026 excluded (line 91): 'No linked Tasks with type Depend — no remediation to verify'.
